reason: ASL.b #2,D2 modifies only the low byte. The upstream expectation changes the upper 24 bits. Preserve those bits and use the byte result and CCR independently confirmed by the analogous MAME vectors.
evidence: MAME record 625: 0xA370CDBE -> 0xA370CDF8, CCR 0A; record 695: 0x104DA87D -> 0x104DA8F4, CCR 1B. Both encode ASL.b #2,D7 and log ten clocks (read four, internal six). These are analogous operands, not identical full states.
User approved these overrides after comparing the original records, byte semantics and MAME data on 2026-10-11.
